candidates.formal_type:
{k : Type u_1} →
  {Q : Type u_2} →
    [inst : CommRing.{u_1} k] →
      [inst_1 : DecidableEq.{u_2 + 1} Q] →
        [instQ : Quiver.{u_3, u_2} Q] →
          {i : Q} →
            (hi : Etingof.IsSource.{u_2, u_3} Q i) →
              [inst_2 : Fintype.{max u_3 u_2} (Etingof.ArrowsOutOf.{u_2, u_3} Q i)] →
                CategoryTheory.Adjunction.{max (max u_4 u_3) u_2, max (max u_4 u_3) u_2,
                    max (max (max u_1 (u_4 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)) (u_2 + 1),
                    max (max (max u_1 (u_4 + 1)) (u_3 + 1)) (u_2 + 1)}
                  (Etingof.reflectionFunctorMinusAdjunctionLeft.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} hi)
                  (Etingof.reflectionFunctorPlusAdjunctionRight.{u_1, u_2, u_3, u_4} hi)
